source_audit.policy_measurement: Replay observed source and old feedback only, no counterfactual model score.
source_audit.scope_gate: Both exact semantic errors must be refused, same-number genuine global final and verified in-task candidate controls must remain eligible. Any additional known wrongful authority or unresolved semantic role with a destructive action must block model pilot. Scope challenge evidence remains separate from deployment guarantees.

cpu_admission.split: Current solver measurements use development cases only. Freeze independent whole families or structurally distinct tasks only after admission. Different n/k or seed within a family is a within-family split, never cross-family evidence.
cpu_admission.quality_rule: First independently verified output meets the identical frozen target. Missing or solver-limited output is censored or unknown. Author or generated witnesses confirm satisfiability outside model material.
cpu_admission.cost_rule: Report monotonic first-verified wall time with startup/construction/solve/validation boundaries and tool settings. Charge local repair and its expansion separately. Use the fastest legal strong solver and local exact repair in the same task scope.
cpu_admission.pilot_gate: At least two frozen satisfiable development instances with substantive headroom against both the strongest direct portfolio and the strongest matched local exact repair, and a feasible independent whole-family design. A case with a checked same-target answer from any legal strong baseline inside the short screen is not evidence of missing solver headroom. Retest a screen miss before using it as positive evidence, unless the other legal baseline already settles that case.
model_payload_allowlist: trusted point or local predicate interface

if_pilot_eligible: Freeze equal-state alternatives, budget and 12–24 independently sourced questions only after a meaningful development pilot. Retain exact local solver, native, prompt, iterative checker and resampling comparisons. Otherwise close this stage at a reported qualification no-go with no model score.
